method: Engine compact setter (argument 1) and clear routine (argument 0) each executed once on a new thread in the game process, after identity, routine-signature and mode-group checks; run by the user. Window recorded at ~33 fps across the hold.
observation: Entering stop mode cuts in one frame from the gameplay camera to a closer pause camera without the waypoint marker; leaving cuts back in one frame. Same view as the byte-level enter.
scope: One native enter/leave. Shows the pause camera cut is part of the engine pause path, not an artefact of skipping the native notification. Does not observe what the notification changes internally.
